summary: Iteration 88 — Phase F 'Promoted Marketplace' e2e verification on web + mobile. BACKEND: 17/17 pytest passed against merchant + admin + ranking endpoints. Tiers endpoint returns exactly 3 tiers (spotlight_7 $19.99/7d w=1, boost_14 $34.99/14d w=2, premium_30 $59.99/30d w=3). GET /api/merchant/marketplace/promotion returns {business_id, public_name, active, items[]}. POST checkout with a valid tier returns a real Stripe hosted checkout URL + cs_ session id + promo_ id, and persists a pending_payment row. bad_tier -> 400, unauth -> 401. Admin list works for status=all/active/rejected filters; non-admin (merchant) -> 403. Admin reject on a pending_payment promo persists status=rejected. Admin grant on a valid biz+tier activates instantly and expose active promotion to the merchant (test@ granted premium_30). grant with bad tier -> 400 / bad business -> 404. Admin approve directly transitions to active with activated_at + expires_at set. GET /api/shop/home has a 'promoted' section titled 'Promoted near you' with the seeded biz_sample_ambreens present; GET /api/shop/businesses?sort=featured ranks ALL promoted items strictly before non-promoted, and each card exposes promoted=true + promotion_weight>=1. WEB: /shop/merchant/promote (rl-merchant-promote-page) renders all 3 tier cards (promote-tier-spotlight_7/boost_14/premium_30) + buy buttons (promote-buy-*) + promote-active banner (test@ has an active promotion after prior grant). Merchant Dashboard at /shop/merchant shows merchant-open-promote tile and it routes to the promote page. /admin/promotions (admin-promotions-page) shows all 4 tabs (promo-tab-pending_review|active|rejected|all), grant form (promo-grant-biz + promo-grant-tier + promo-grant-btn) which comped Fun Pizza Kitchen live from the UI showing 'Comped promotion is live' toast; Active tab lists 5 promo-row-* cards (Ambreens, TEST_iter57_pickup x2, Fun Pizza Kitchen x2). adnav-merchants-promotions is present in the admin sidebar when the Users & Businesses section is expanded (visible on /admin/promotions). Shop Home rail 'Promoted near you' renders with 13 orange 'Promoted' badges + 5 'Sponsored' fallbacks. MOBILE (Expo web preview @ 390x844): after demo-login-btn, /merchant/dashboard shows the merchant-open-promote tile and taps into /merchant/promote which renders promote-root + all 3 promote-tier-* cards + promote-buy-* buttons — demo user has a marketplace profile in this env (TEST_iter56_be7440), NOT the empty state, but the screen renders correctly either way. Shop tab shows 8 orange 'Promoted' badges parity. No react-native red screen. No deprecated packages introduced by this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/marketplace_promotions.py:161-176 — admin_approve does not gate on current status. A promo that is still 'pending_payment' (no Stripe payment received) can be approved directly and its business becomes promoted. That is convenient for QA / comp-like paths, but consider requiring status in ('pending_review','pending_payment') and refusing to re-activate an already-rejected promotion. Today, a 'rejected' promo is silently re-activated on approve. Low-risk since only admins can hit it, but worth tightening.

backend/routes/marketplace_promotions.py:178-186 — admin_reject accepts a reject on any status (including 'active') without also clearing promoted_until / promotion_weight on the marketplace_profile. If an admin rejects an already-active promo, the shop stays boosted until natural expiry. Consider revoking _apply_active when rejecting an active row.

backend/routes/marketplace_promotions.py:90-120 — checkout leaks a pending_payment row for every button-press regardless of whether the merchant returns to Stripe. Consider auto-expiring stale pending_payment rows > 24h, so /api/merchant/marketplace/promotion 'items' history doesn't fill up with dead sessions.

backend/routes/marketplace_promotions.py:60-65 — _apply_active blindly overwrites promoted_until / promotion_tier / promotion_weight on every approve/grant. If a higher-tier promotion is still active, granting a lower-tier one demotes the shop's weight until the higher expires. Consider only overwriting if new expiry > current expiry or new weight >= current weight.

Admin can approve promos regardless of status (see code-review note #1). Mobile 'Promoted near you' rail heading was not directly asserted via Playwright due to React Native ScrollView not responding to window.scrollBy, but 8 orange 'Promoted' badges rendered — matches iter87's live screenshot verification. If you need to trigger the pending_review state without paying, POST /api/merchant/marketplace/promotion/{id}/status only flips it after Stripe reports paid; the simpler path is admin grant (comp) which activates instantly.
